kaikki_vikisozluk.e: تَاجِر • (tājir) m (plural تَاجِرُون (tājirūn) or تُجَّار (tujjār), feminine تَاجِرَة (tājira))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Borrowed from Classical Syriac ܬܓܪܐ (taggārā); perhaps it was loaned as تُجَّار (tujjār), which was then analyzed as a plural for a singular تَاجِر (tājir) to be derived by back-formation.
The Syriac descends through a form *tangār from Akkadian 𒁮𒃼 (tamkārum, “trader”). Doublet of مَاكِر (mākir, “planner, schemer”).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: تَاجَرَ • (tājara) III (non-past يُتَاجِرُ (yutājiru), verbal noun مُتَاجَرَة (mutājara))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Akkadian 𒈠𒅗𒀸 (makārum)
Akkadian 𒁮𒃼 (tamkārum)der.
Classical Syriac ܬܓܪܐ (taggārā)bor.
Arabic تَاجِر (tājir)denom.
Arabic تاجر
Denominal verb from تَاجِر (tājir).
